values.website: A versatile industrial gateway on MediaTek MT7621 with 5G/4G, Wi-Fi 5, RS485, RS232, 512 MB RAM, and configurable Gigabit WAN/LAN ports. Suited for custom industrial edge applications, equipment integration, and adaptive enterprise networking.
values.catalogue: A versatile industrial gateway on MediaTek MT7621 with 5G/4G, Wi-Fi 5, RS485, RS232, 512 MB RAM, and configurable Gigabit WAN/LAN ports. Suited for custom industrial edge applications, equipment integration, and adaptive enterprise networking.

values.website:
Custom Industrial Edge Application Development
Industrial Equipment Integration & Control
Adaptive Enterprise & Industrial Networking
values.catalogue:
Custom Industrial Edge Application Development — Suitable for OEMs and system integrators to develop custom edge applications using Shell scripting, C, and C++ for automation, protocol conversion, and local data processing.
Industrial Equipment Integration & Control — Can connect PLCs, sensors, controllers, and legacy industrial equipment through RS485/RS232, DI/O, and AI interfaces for centralized monitoring and control.
Adaptive Enterprise & Industrial Networking — Ideal for commercial buildings, factories, and distributed sites requiring flexible WAN/LAN configuration, secure VPN access, and scalable network deployment.
